title: Causal openness lets self-conscious beings choose

statements.text: The causal openness of quantum systems gives self-conscious beings the ability to make independent choices, a self-governance in which to be free is not to act randomly but to choose between lines of conduct.

sources.quote: The causal openness of quantum systems provides self-conscious beings the ability to make independent choices and decisions
To be free is not to act randomly, but to choose between different lines of conduct
